### [城市空间与环境过程](space-process/)
Urban Space &amp; Environmental Processes

<p>空间条件与空间干预如何产生环境效应？这些效应又如何随时间、尺度与气候条件发生变化？</p>
:::
:::
::: {.project-row .thread-clay}
<div><span class="project-kicker">02 · 人与环境</span></div>
::: {}
### [人与环境交互](human-environment/)
Human–Environment Interaction

<p>环境条件如何转化为人的暴露、感知、行为与健康，并进一步影响空间设计？</p>
:::
:::

Environmental Sensing, Modelling &amp; Computation

## Funded Projects {.initial-accent}
:::

::: {.funded-project-group}
### Projects led by Owl Lab

::: {.funded-project .funded-project-led .thread-violet}
<div class="funded-project-meta"><span>2027–2029</span><span>国家自然科学基金青年项目 · PI</span></div>
<h3>面向适老步行的城市新区街道动态热暴露机制与空间优化研究——以夏热冬冷地区为例</h3>
<p>面向夏热冬冷地区适老步行场景，研究城市新区街道中的动态热暴露机制，并探索支持街道空间优化的设计路径。</p>
<div class="funded-project-tags"><span>人与环境交互</span><span>城市空间与环境过程</span></div>
:::

::: {.funded-project .funded-project-led .thread-sage}
<div class="funded-project-meta"><span>2026–2028</span><span>江苏省自然科学基金青年项目 · PI</span></div>
<h3>城市街区更新中精准增绿的热环境提升边界与空间配置方法研究</h3>
<p>围绕城市街区更新中的精准增绿，研究热环境提升边界与空间配置方法，为更新中的增绿决策提供依据。</p>
<div class="funded-project-tags"><span>城市空间与环境过程</span></div>
:::

::: {.funded-project .funded-project-led .thread-blue-grey}
<div class="funded-project-meta"><span>2025–2027</span><span>教育部高密度人居环境生态与节能实验室开放课题 · PI</span></div>
<h3>基于可解释人工智能（XAI）的城市蓝绿空间降温效应动态机制与优化研究</h3>
<p>关注城市蓝绿空间降温效应的动态机制与优化问题，探索可解释人工智能支持下的空间配置研究路径。</p>
<div class="funded-project-tags"><span>城市空间与环境过程</span><span>环境感知、建模与计算</span></div>
:::

::: {.funded-project .funded-project-led .thread-blue-grey}
<div class="funded-project-meta"><span>2025–2026</span><span>自然资源部国土空间规划监测评估预警重点实验室开放基金课题 · PI</span></div>
<h3>面向热韧性提升的城市更新蓝绿空间智能布局及优化方法研究</h3>
<p>面向热韧性提升，研究城市更新中蓝绿空间的智能布局与优化方法，为热韧性导向的空间更新提供支持。</p>
<div class="funded-project-tags"><span>城市空间与环境过程</span><span>环境感知、建模与计算</span></div>
:::
:::
:::

### 01 Urban Space &amp; Environmental Processes
<p class="publication-title-zh">城市空间与环境过程</p>

::: {.publication-entry}
<span>2020</span><div><h4>The cooling efficiency of variable greenery coverage ratios in different urban densities: A study in a subtropical climate.</h4><p>Ouyang, W., Morakinyo, T. E., Ren, C., &amp; Ng, E. <em>Building and Environment</em>, 174, 106772.</p><div class="publication-description"><strong class="publication-microhead">绿量 × 城市密度：降温效率如何变化？</strong><span class="publication-explanation">比较不同绿化覆盖率与城市密度组合下的冷却表现，理解空间背景如何影响绿化的环境效应。</span></div><a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.buildenv.2020.106772">DOI / View paper →</a></div>
:::
::: {.publication-entry}
<span>2023</span><div><h4>How to quantify the cooling effects of green infrastructure strategies from a spatio-temporal perspective: Experience from a parametric study.</h4><p>Ouyang, W., Morakinyo, T. E., Lee, Y., Tan, Z., Ren, C., &amp; Ng, E. <em>Landscape and Urban Planning</em>, 237, 104808.</p><div class="publication-description"><strong class="publication-microhead">多维度量化降温效果。</strong><span class="publication-explanation">从时空视角量化不同绿化策略的冷却表现，进一步理解环境效应如何在空间与时间中变化。</span></div><a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.landurbplan.2023.104808">DOI / View paper →</a></div>
:::
::: {.publication-entry}
<span>2025</span><div><h4>The dual impacts of built environment on extreme heat and urban heat resilience: A comparative study in Beijing.</h4><p>Liu, Q., Ouyang, W., Tan, Z., Mei, Y., &amp; Bai, B. <em>Urban Climate</em>, 64, 102618.</p><div class="publication-description"><strong class="publication-microhead">空间如何同时塑造极端热与热韧性？</strong><span class="publication-explanation">从极端热事件出发，考察建成环境属性与热暴露水平及城市热韧性之间的关系。</span></div><a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.uclim.2025.102618">DOI / View paper →</a></div>
:::
:::

<span>2021</span><div><h4>Evaluating the thermal-radiative performance of ENVI-met model for green infrastructure typologies: Experience from a subtropical climate.</h4><p>Ouyang, W., Sinsel, T., Simon, H., Morakinyo, T.
